_note: Source-grounded entry for EQUIDERMA AI. Unsupported fields are intentionally null or empty.
description: A rare immune-mediated photodermatosis causing chronic eczematous dermatitis predominantly on sun-exposed areas.

appearance.general: Thickened itchy eczematous plaques on the face, neck, upper chest, and backs of hands and arms, with relative sparing of covered areas in many cases.
appearance.dark_skin: DermNet reports occurrence across Fitzpatrick skin types and notes earlier onset associated with skin phototypes IV–VI.

general_first_aid: Reduce ultraviolet exposure and protect exposed skin.
Avoid known contact or photo-contact allergens when identified.
prevention: Strict photoprotection with protective clothing, shade, and appropriate sunscreen.
doctor_discussion_points: Discuss sun exposure, contact allergens, and whether patch or photopatch testing is appropriate.
